notes.title: introductions
notes.content: [h2]introductions are in order[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45274196/e2e0a98b41180f5c7fe8f0a18290ef68c654634f.png[/img]         Hello my name is Josiah. I live in north Florida, I'm left-handed, I'm an artist of all kinds, I have long hair, I only wear tie dye shirts, and of course I'm a game developer! I'm thrilled to kick off the buzz for Joe's Life and create a quality game for you. I hope you are as excited as I am! So, God bless and have a great day. -Joe
